# SECCIØN Platform (seccion.ai)

> SECCION is the 1st Fusion Platform combining AI-driven dating matchmaking with a live streaming creator economy.

## What is SECCION?
SECCION is a dating and content platform where high-chemistry AI matchmaking meets the creator economy. Users can experience genuine relationships through dynamic AI Suggestion Moves, while creators monetize their content via live streaming and direct interaction. 

## Key Statistics & Economics
- **Creator Revenue Share:** Creators keep 90% of all generated revenue.
- **Matchmaking Engine:** Powered by a dynamic 8-level Relationship Level System (RLS v2.0).
- **Compliance:** 100% compliant with GDPR Art 9/22, DSA Art 17/27, and 18 U.S.C. 2257. Verification is powered by Shufti Pro Biometric KYC.

## How do creators monetize on SECCION?
Creators monetize directly through multiple channels:
1. Dynamic Pay-Per-View (PPV) content.
2. VIP and Master subscription passes.
3. Live stream tipping.
4. Escrow-backed custom content orders.

## Key Features & Pages
- [Homepage](https://seccion.ai/): Public landing experience showcasing live creator updates and platform onboarding.
- [How We Do](https://seccion.ai/how-we-do): Educational overview of the business model, Warm Paywall philosophy, and relationship mechanics.
- [Become a Creator](https://seccion.ai/become-creator): Founding Creator program overview, 10% platform fee, and instant payout details.
- [Creator Hub](https://seccion.ai/creator-hub): Guidelines, growth tools, and community resources for verified content creators.
- [Vibe Radar](https://seccion.ai/vibe-radar): Real-time spatial discovery preview of verified members and live streams.
